Class AccountContactRelationTriggerHelper

public inherited sharing class AccountContactRelationTriggerHelper

Trigger helper for the AccountContactRelation object. Contains business logic invoked by AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler for managing email notification subscriptions, main contact designation, and BlazeBite agent count tracking.

Methods

public static void handleDuplicatedEmailNotifications(AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler handler)

Validates that email notification subscriptions are not duplicated across contacts on the same account. Checks EmailNotifications__c values against configurable duplicate rules from CodeSettings and adds an error to the record if duplicates are found.

Parameters:
    handler – The AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler instance providing field change detection

public static void handleMultipleMainContacts(AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler handler)

Ensures only one contact per account is designated as the main notification contact for each notification type. When multiple contacts are flagged as main, keeps the first and unchecks the rest. When no main contact is defined, automatically promotes the most recently modified non-agent contact.

Parameters:
    handler – The AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler instance providing field change detection

public static void updateNumberOfAgentsAssigned(AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler handler)

Recalculates and updates NumberOfAgentsAssigned__c on each affected account by counting active BlazeBite agent relations via AccountContactRelationSelector.countBlazeBiteAgents. Handles both insert/update and delete trigger contexts.

Parameters:
    handler – The AccountContactRelationTriggerHandler instance
